text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the salads either lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and the venison chili was described as bland. There were also concerns about the limited menu range and the absence of basic service items like cups for water. Additionally, some visitors felt the food was overpriced given the portion sizes. These points suggest a need to review and improve the food offerings and service amenities.

Several reviews mention bland or poorly executed menu items, limited choices, and dissatisfaction with the quality and flavor of dishes. There are also complaints about long wait times and inconsistent service, including periods when orders could not be taken due to kitchen delays. Some visitors feel the food is overpriced given the portion sizes and options available. Attention to menu variety, food preparation, and service efficiency would likely improve the overall visitor experience.
